headline: The biggest games of October 2026
title: Biggest Games of October 2026 | Gears E-Day, CoD MW4, Phantom Blade Zero | Gaming News
video_script: October twenty twenty six is stacked for gamers! Gears of War: E-Day arrived on October sixth. Dragon's Dogma 2's Dark Arisen expansion on October ninth. Castlevania: Belmont's Curse on October fifteenth. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 lands on October twenty third. And Phantom Blade Zero hits PS5 and PC on October twenty ninth. Which one are you playing? Comment below!
description: October 2026's big games: Gears of War: E-Day (Oct 6), Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen (Oct 9), Castlevania: Belmont's Curse (Oct 15), Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 (Oct 23), Phantom Blade Zero (Oct 29).
